decision_rationale: Primary model paper with broad pretraining on 65 angiosperm genomes and a masked-language-model objective. The evidence supports foundation-model-like pretraining, but it does not explicitly show a genuinely generative architecture.
evidence_snippet: pre-trained on 65 angiosperm genomes ... masked language modeling objective applied to 8,192 bp input sequences

decision_rationale: This is a transcriptomics-conditioned molecule generation framework using a molecular GPT model plus a scRNA-seq foundation model. The paper presents a primary generative model rather than a wrapper.
evidence_snippet: a transcriptomics-based molecule generation framework ... couples a single-cell RNA-sequencing foundation model with a molecular GPT model

decision_rationale: The model explicitly adds a denoising diffusion module and is pretrained on 34.2 million cells for virtual cell modeling. This is clear generative foundation-model evidence.
evidence_snippet: augmented with a denoising diffusion module ... pre-training on 36.77 million human single-cell transcriptomes

decision_rationale: The paper applies the existing ESM-2 protein language model zero-shot for structural risk scoring. This is an application wrapper, not a new generative model.
evidence_snippet: applies the protein language model ESM-2, without fine-tuning on epidemiological outcome labels

decision_rationale: The full text describes an auto-encoder with an explicit decoder and generative sampling, trained self-supervised on a large protein corpus. It also reports task-agnostic generation and transfer across protein families.
evidence_snippet: “support generative sampling” and “a one-step recycling iteration ... improves quality and diversity”

decision_rationale: The record describes a transfer-learning framework for universal cell embeddings, not a generative model. It does show broad pretrained language-model embeddings and cross-species transfer.
evidence_snippet: “learns universal cell embeddings” by combining RNA expression with embeddings from protein language models and general-purpose language models

decision_rationale: scMIR is presented as a pretrained vision-language representation model with reconstruction and alignment modules, but the outputs are task-agnostic embeddings rather than generated outputs. The evidence supports foundation-model-like pretraining and broad applicability.
evidence_snippet: “pre-trained on 207,957 image-text pairs” and “outputs task-agnostic image embeddings”

decision_rationale: This is a training and reasoning framework around an LLM policy, with teacher-generated CoT data, rather than evidence of a new broadly pretrained foundation model. The model itself is described as generating responses autoregressively.
evidence_snippet: “the model outputs a textual response y generated autoregressively according to the policy”

decision_rationale: The core model is a Qwen3.5-9B language-model backbone adapted with LoRA and used to generate natural-language explanations. The contribution is a biomedical framework built around an existing foundation model.
evidence_snippet: a single nine-billion-parameter language model (Qwen3.5-9B) ... generates natural-language explanations of its outputs

decision_rationale: spEMO integrates existing foundation models and uses GPT-4o/o1 to generate medical reports. The main contribution is a multimodal application framework, not a new generative model.
evidence_snippet: spEMO can generate medical reports ... multi-modal agents used in this task are GPT-4o and o1

decision_rationale: This is an empirical analysis of existing single-cell foundation models, not a new model contribution. The models discussed are masked-token transcriptome models rather than a new generative architecture.
evidence_snippet: single-cell foundation models (SCFMs) ... trained with the same masked-token recipe on transcriptomes

decision_rationale: The selected sections only describe construction of gene regulatory networks from PubTator3 relations. No foundation-model or generative architecture is evidenced.
evidence_snippet: Gene regulatory relationships were obtained from the pre-annotated PubTator3 table ...
